items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: So they sent for me, and they said, 'Senator Lebeau wants to see you. He wants to thank you for making that record.' ... 'Senator Dudley Lebeau wants to see you. He's coming to town next week; he has a present for you.'

ctx.x: But it wasn't all over before then. I'll tell you what happened. It wasn't all over then. He would say, "She can drink a lot of Hadicol," "Oh, no, she can't," "Oh yes, she can." You had a disk jockey here named Papa Stoppa(?) who used to take just that part when he was publicizing the Hadicol(?) thing. "You know, you can do a lot of Hadicol..." -- and he'd play that over and over and over and over, see.

So somebody found out I was here. So they sent for me, and they said, "Senator Lebeau wants to see you. He wants to thank you for making that record." Because they wanted to get off the hook, because I guess the government was suing them for using that as a gimmick. So he said, "Senator Lebeau..." He called me, Papa Stoppa. He said, "Hey, Danny Barker?" I said, "Yeah." He said, "I want to see you. Come down to my office at the hotel, the Louisiana(?) Hotel. I want to see you and I want to talk to you." He said,…
He was supposed to give me a watch.
